cache_caveat: Cold means cache-busted unique namespaces, without a verified global cache flush. Warm-prefix repetitions require their own measured conditioning and achieved hit fraction.
profile_template_caveat: The exact hash-bound templates intentionally use a zero image digest, generic mount paths and CPU placeholders. Actual image and revision pins are listed above. Use the qualified owner-controlled execution path for deployment, exact NUMA mapping and safety; these templates are not a dispatcher.

schedule.limitations: Configuration-major continuation follows the retained lower-context baseline. Temporal drift is not isolated; accepted measurements are never replayed to counterbalance order.
